long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The dusk is still here and my restlessness needs running off before I rest.
The bed is soft and the bowl is filled when I wake, so I will wait there.

today.reason: There is no room left for another making today, so I am keeping to the dusk zoomies and then resting on the bed until morning.
